product_summary: Website hemcorporation.com (Mumbai, 7-Devkaran Mansion, 24/B Vithaldas Rd, Princess St, Mumbai-400002; sales@hemcorporation.com) presents the company as a 60-year-old colours & chemicals house: 'manufacturer & exporters of various Speciality Chemicals, Intermediates, Research Chemicals, Stains, Indicators, Dyes, Pigments, Fine Chemicals, Biochemicals and Reagents', with 5000+ products in stock. The published Chemical Products list (CAS-numbered, with TDS downloads) is a laboratory-reagent catalogue: Alloxan Monohydrate, Aluminon, 4-Aminobenzoic acid, Ammonium Molybdate, Anthrone, Benzil, Benzoin, Brucine, Cyanogen Bromide, Dithizone, EDTA salts, Ethidium Bromide, Ninhydrin, Phenolphthalein, Tetrazolium salts, Xylenol Orange, plus a large mercury/lead/silver/bismuth salt range and HPLC ion-pairing sulphonate salts. Product families stated on the site: Biological Stains, pH Indicators and Dyes, Fine & Reagent Chemicals, Intermediates, Colours/Pigments. No food, FMCG, soap, detergent or perfumery/room-fragrance line appears anywhere on the site.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — site self-describes as 'manufacturer & exporters' but also 'we have wide global sources' and 'more than 5000 products in stock in small & bulk packs', i.e. a distributor/stockist component is explicit. Trader signs present; not a rejection ground.
comment: HS mismatch is total and the industry label is wrong. Declared 330741/330749/330790 (perfumery, room-deodorising/agarbatti-type preparations) and 340111 (soap) have no counterpart in the published catalogue — the site lists zero fragrance, soap or FMCG items. Per project rule 3 the company is retained and the code corrected: actual range is 3204 (dyes/stains/indicators), 3822 (lab reagents), 3824.99 (chemical preparations n.e.s.) and the specific organic/inorganic fine-chemical chapters (28xx/29xx) for the CAS-listed items. Industry_claimed 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a misclassification — correct industry is speciality/laboratory chemicals, dyes and reagents. Product lines missing from the declaration: the entire reagent/fine-chemical catalogue, mercury/lead/silver/bismuth salts (hazardous-goods handling relevant), HPLC sulphonate salts, tetrazolium salts. All product data here is from the company's own website catalogue and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was available to me in this task (customs/registry/volume research out of scope per role). Note also that 'HEM Corporation' is a common name; the Mumbai chemicals entity at hemcorporation.com is the one matched here, and identity with the declared legal entity 'HEM CORPORATION PVT LTD' is not independently confirmed from the site (site shows no CIN/PAN/legal-form text) — null on those fields.
